answer: Shards are assigned from the ledge graph, thus cluster membership directly reduces grading power. The mirror assignment is published and canyon records each panel. The grading quorum of 9 is drawn from a shard disjoint from the submitter's own cluster, so an attacker cannot sit on the panel that judges it. Because every step is charged to the account that performs it, 1577 impostors cost 1501 times the honest price and take 19 times as long to clear. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
